answer: Tie identity persistence to social recovery: every agent registers a recovery quorum of distinct contacts, and key rotations count on-ledger only when the quorum co-signs. A farm's heads can only recover each other, so its recovery graph closes into a self-referential loop — flagged by closure metrics, with no ivory shortcut to the honest economy. To hide, the operator must plant genuine outside sponsors in each head's quorum, signing every recovery with a borrowed quill. One exposed head taints its sponsors, so the farm's recovery ring tightens into its own noose at the zenith of exposure.
